game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Snow Fort, a snowball fort: the firewood keeper must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Docstring Detective: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snow Fort: a snowball fort
core_gameplay_loop: In Snow Fort, repeat each round: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the cases value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the hearth fire using at most 23 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The hearth fire reached with actions_used <= 23.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 23 before the hearth fire is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Docstring Detective
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Docstring Detective' (Week 6 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Snow Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Snow Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The hearth fire reached with actions_used <= 23.
